question: Which additional festival observances are included among the prescribed ritual celebrations?
premises: The verse continues an enumeration of ritual observances.
A festival marking the beginning of the year is included.
A festival known as the spring festival is also included.
inference: The prescribed celebrations include the year-beginning festival and the festival called the spring festival.
uncertainties: The exact ritual character of saṃvatsādikhelā is not specified beyond being a festival or sport.
plain_english: And also the year-beginning festival, and that festival known as the spring festival.
